segments.name: Tinder
segments.evidence: Tinder consists of the world-wide activity of the brand Tinder®.

segments.name: Hinge
segments.description: Operates the Hinge brand, a mobile-only app for users seeking intentional, relationship-oriented connections.
segments.evidence: Hinge consists of the world-wide activity of the brand Hinge®.

segments.name: Evergreen & Emerging
segments.description: Operates established online dating brands and newer affinity-based brands serving specific communities and demographics worldwide.
segments.evidence: Evergreen & Emerging ("E&E") consists of the world-wide activity of our Evergreen brands, including Match®, Meetic®, OkCupid®, Plenty Of Fish®, and a number of demographically focused brands, and our Emerging brands, including BLK®, Chispa™, The League®, Archer®, Upward®, Yuzu™, Salams®, HER™, and other smaller brands.

segments.name: Match Group Asia
segments.description: Operates the Pairs and Azar brands serving Asian and Middle Eastern dating and video chat markets.
segments.evidence: Match Group Asia ("MG Asia") consists of the world-wide activity of the brands Pairs™ and Azar®.

revenueModel.text: Users pay directly for subscriptions and à la carte premium features, and the company also earns advertising revenue from third parties.
revenueModel.evidence: Direct Revenue is revenue that is received directly from end users of our services and includes both subscription and à la carte revenue.

changes.text: In 2024, the company terminated certain live streaming services and shut down the Hakuna app.
changes.evidence: impairments of intangible assets at E&E and MG Asia in the prior year as a result of the termination of certain of our live streaming services and the Hakuna app in 2024.
